_comment: App entity fact sheet: the machine readable mirror of the App entity section in brand/PRODUCT_FACTS.md. The human owns these facts; the compliance agent maintains them with the human; the app-store-optimization agent keeps the store listings in line with them. app_entity_check.py (ai-search-optimization skill) reads name, developer, category, website, ios.app_id, android.package and prices; every other key is for people and agents. Replace every placeholder, delete the ios or android block if the app is not on that store, and write prices exactly as the website and the store page you check display them (4.99 and 4,99 do not match). Facts only, each traceable to a PRODUCT_FACTS.md row; no marketing copy. Guide: skills/app-store-optimization/references/app-web-presence-for-ai.md section 7.
